title: Winey American Cranberry Wrap
description: A wine-glazed, pillowy, adventurous American dish featuring fresh cranberries and wrapped in a leaf for steaming, all while being Whole30 friendly.

ingredients.name: Cranberry sauce
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought, low sugar content.

ingredients.name: Feta cheese crumbles
ingredients.notes: Optional, Whole30 compliant alternative: cashew cheese.

ingredients.name: Honey
ingredients.notes: For wine glaze, adjust to taste.

ingredients.name: White wine
ingredients.notes: For wine glaze, adjust to taste.

instructions: In a small saucepan, combine honey and white wine. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add cranberry sauce to the pan and stir to combine. Continue to cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the glaze has thickened slightly and reduced by half.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add diced turkey breast and cook until heated through, breaking up with a spoon as needed.
Add chopped pecans (if using) to the skillet and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
To assemble the wraps, lay a Bibb lettuce leaf flat and spoon a portion of the turkey and pecan mixture onto the center of the leaf.
Drizzle with the wine glaze and top with mixed greens, feta cheese crumbles (if using), and a sprinkle of fresh thyme (if using).
Fold the leaf in half over the filling to enclose and serve immediately.

To steam the wraps, place a steamer basket over a pot of boiling water and add the wraps, seam-side down. Cover the pot with a lid and steam for 2-3 minutes, or until the leaves are slightly wilted and the filling is heated through.
